name: Devourer of Souls
summary: Devourer of Souls is the opening task in an aspiring Horde warlock's journey to summon and command a succubus. Offered by Gan'rul Bloodeye deep within the Cleft of Shadow, the quest sends the practitioner across the cavern to consult the ancient warlock Cazul on how to lure and bind such a manipulative demon.

sections.title: A Step Into Seductive Shadows
sections.body: Warlocks of the Horde who have mastered lesser demons like the imp and the voidwalker eventually reach a point where brute force is no longer enough. Gan'rul Bloodeye, overseer of dark arts beneath Orgrimmar, judges when a warlock is ready to reach into the Twisting Nether for a succubus—a creature notorious for turning the minds of the frail against themselves. Binding such a fiend requires subtle methods rather than sheer strength.

sections.title: The Lore of Cazul
sections.body: Because a succubus preys on mortal desires, it cannot be summoned by raw incantations alone; it must be baited into our world with an object imbued with pure love and devotion. Unwilling or unable to provide such a relic himself, Gan'rul directs the summoner to Cazul, an ancient warlock lurking within the Cleft of Shadow whose extensive knowledge of the arcane and demonic rites guides the next phase of the ritual.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Devourer of Souls initiates the Horde quest chain required to learn the ritual to summon a succubus minion. It connects you with mentors in the Cleft of Shadow who teach you the nature of the demon and how to lure one from the Twisting Nether.

Cazul is located within the Cleft of Shadow, the subterranean cavern hidden beneath Orgrimmar where the city's rogue and warlock trainers practice their forbidden arts away from the scrutiny of the Warchief.

faq.q: Why does a warlock need an object of love to summon a succubus?
faq.answer: Succubi are demonic manipulators that feed upon mortal emotion, devotion, and weak will. To draw one across the veil of the Twisting Nether, a summoner must offer a potent talisman of genuine devotion and affection as bait before overpowering and binding the creature.

Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior warlock trainer of the Horde residing in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He guides developing practitioners through the dangerous bindings of increasingly powerful demonic servants.

faq.q: What level is required to begin this quest?
faq.answer: A warlock must reach level 20 before Gan'rul Bloodeye considers their magical prowess and mental fortitude sufficient to undertake the ritual and survive bargaining with a succubus.

faq.q: What follows after speaking with Cazul?
aliases: next quest after devourer of souls
faq.answer: Speaking to Cazul leads into the quest 'Blind Cazul', which sends the summoner into the field across the Barrens and Stonetalon Mountains to locate a suitable token of love and find a captured grunt named Dogran.

angles.text: This quest marks your transition into commanding demons of mental dominance and seduction, demanding psychological resolve as well as raw fel power.
Unlike the public shamans and warriors of Thrall's Horde, warlocks must conduct these dangerous rites hidden away within the damp, secluded crevices of the Cleft of Shadow.
